REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: The RCA schema permits unsupported model blame through contributing causes, bypassing the counterfactual-evidence rule enforced for a model-profile primary cause.
FINDING: high|docs/factory-ng/schemas/factory.root-cause-analysis-v1.schema.json|contributing_causes accepts arbitrary strings and triggers no counterfactual requirement|an RCA can blame Qwen or model_profile without evidence, violating the provenance-versus-causality contract
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Restrict contributing_causes to the causal taxonomy and require nonempty counterfactual_evidence whenever model_profile is asserted as either primary or contributing; add a failing fixture for unsupported contributing-model attribution.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: {"primary_cause":"harness_or_gate","contributing_causes":["Qwen caused it"],"evidence":["hidden holdout failed"],"corrective_ticket_ids":[],"status":"open"} passes without counterfactual evidence.
